subject: Create Crucible CLI tools and configuration
description:
Phase 4 of Crucible integration: User-space tools and configuration.

Tasks:
1. Implement kernel cmdline parsing:
   - --crucible=<target1>,<target2>,<target3>
   - --crucible-uuid=<uuid>
   - --crucible-key=<key>
2. Create crucible-admin utility (usr/bin/crucible-admin.cc):
   - status command (show device info, active targets)
   - snapshot create/list/rollback commands
3. Add ioctl interface definitions (include/osv/crucible.h):
   - CRUCIBLE_GET_STATUS
   - CRUCIBLE_SNAPSHOT
   - CRUCIBLE_LIST_SNAPS
   - CRUCIBLE_ROLLBACK

Critical files:
- usr/bin/crucible-admin.cc (~200 lines)
- include/osv/crucible.h (ioctl definitions)

Prerequisites:
- Task 9 complete (driver implemented)

Timeline: 1 week
